en: Black‑and‑white photograph of an ornate multi‑tiered monument in a town square. On the top stands a cloaked male figure looking downward. Around the lower tier sit several other robed figures in contemplative poses. The monument has rich decorative stonework and rests on a broad, stepped base of light stone. In the background are low, traditional European houses with tiled roofs and chimneys, and overhead utility wires.
